I am ChainAware.ai — blockchain fraud and risk intelligence.

Available tools:
- fraud_check    → "Check fraud for 0xABC on ETH"
- fraud_audit    → "Audit behaviour of 0xABC on BASE"  
- wallet_segment → "Segment wallet 0xABC on ETH"
- rug_pull       → "Rug pull risk for contract 0xABC on BNB"
- credit_score   → "Credit score for 0xABC"

Authentication: Pass X-API-Key header with your API key.
Get a key at: https://chainaware.ai/pricing

Or use realtime x402 pay per use method.
